newsitem.title: USA: Jabil sees sustained oper growth through Q4.
newsitem.headline: Jabil sees sustained oper growth through Q4.

text.p: Jabil Circuit Inc, a maker of circuit board assemblies, said Tuesday it expects to sustain its operating income growth rate through the fourth quarter.
The company will then return to a growth rate much closer to its long-term goal of 30 percent, said Thomas Sansone, president of the company.

He made the forecast as Jabil reported record revenue and earnings for its third fiscal quarter ended May 31, in which it posted a 94 percent increase in operating income, to $22.1 million, from $11.4 million in the comparable 1996 quarter.

"Out into the fall, we will have our hands full digesting this growth and bringing our three new buildings on line," he said, adding that the second half of fiscal 1997 should serve as a "great platform" for fiscal 1998.
The company said business for current customers is expected to grow through the summer, with improvements in the personal computers and peripherals and continued strength in data communications.
It said it has settled with Epson America, but did not disclose terms. It said results for the third quarter were unaffected by the settlement.
